findings.title: R10_VALIDATION says the 70 C TCR window limits 7.31 / 7.18 ms were both computed at 5.73 V and not re-run at 5.71 V; 7.18 ms is the 5.713 V figure
findings.contradicts: round26_safety.md line 68 and round26_safety.json observation ('the window limit is 7.31 ms at 5.73 V and 7.18 ms at 5.713 V'), and the worst-corner EN model (D-R25-01 / D-R26-03 corner with the resistor tolerance widened by +/-100 ppm/K x 45 K)
findings.evidence: docs/R10_VALIDATION.md lines 2181-2182 (round 26 index, observations): 'the TCR sensitivity of the window limit (7.31 / 7.18 ms at 70 C, computed at 5.73 V, still above 7 ms; not re-run at 5.71 V)'; the same claim is in round26_fix_docs.md line 74. Re-run (.supervisor/r27_power/tcr.py, Calculation): R80 / R165 470 k +1.45 %, R81 300 k -1.45 %, C87 0.72 x 220 nF, 0.1 uA EN sink, D402 50 nA, VUVLO(F) 1.116 V, one open block per 100 ms: 7.309 ms at 5.73 V and 7.183 ms at 5.7132 V (7.629 / 7.503 ms at the 1 % corner, reproducing D-R26-03). So the pair is one figure per voltage, and the 5.71 V figure exists.
findings.impact: The index tells the owner that the TCR sensitivity at the bench voltage 5.71 V is unknown when it is 7.18 ms, 0.18 ms above the 7 ms line. No rule changes.
findings.concrete_fix: R10_VALIDATION line 2181-2182: '(7.31 ms at 5.73 V and 7.18 ms at 5.71 V, at 70 C; still above 7 ms)'; make the same correction in round26_fix_docs.md item 5.

findings.title: parts_qualification's GAP-3 LDO thermal paragraph still uses the pre-AUX 460 mA allocation: 0.406 W, 102.5-114.7 C and a 135.4 C/W ceiling instead of 0.490 W, 109.2-123.9 C and 112.3 C/W
findings.contradicts: parts_budget.json (generated by r10_parts.py, which the same section says it reports: 'The reproducible values in parts_budget.json ... They give'): ldo_full_load_loss_W 0.48965, ldo_ambient_70C_junction_inference_C [109.17, 123.86], ldo_ambient_85C [124.17, 138.86], port_aux_allowance_A 0.1 (D-R19-14); docs/M3_R10.md line 710 (0.490 W, up to 123.9 C) and docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 2558 (0.490 W, 109.2-123.9 C, 124.2-138.9 C at 85 C)
findings.evidence: m3_design/assembly_review/sources/r10_design/parts_qualification.md lines 673-686, section 'Voltage, current and thermal budgets', not marked historical: 'allocated 460 mA output ... give 0.406177 W ... Junction estimate is 102.494-114.679 C at the 70 C bay ambient ... at 85 C it is 117.494-129.679 C ... the inferred theta ceiling for 125 C at 70 C is 135.409 C/W'. The current allocation is GPS 150 + radio 300 + AUX 100 mA (+10 mA), and r10_parts.py line 516 computes ldo_full_load_loss_W = (buck_max - ldo_min) x (0.46 + aux_A) + buck_max x 0.004 = 0.48965 W. Calculation: 70 + 80 / 110 x 0.48965 = 109.17 / 123.86 C; 85 + ... = 124.17 / 138.86 C; ceiling (125 - 70) / 0.48965 = 112.32 C/W.
findings.impact: The component contract overstates U401's thermal margin: it gives a 135.4 C/W ceiling against the inferred 110 C/W (25 C/W spare) when the real ceiling with the owner-approved AUX allowance is 112.3 C/W (2.3 C/W spare), and a 114.7 C worst junction instead of 123.9 C. The 85 C sensitivity is 138.9 C, not 129.7 C.
findings.concrete_fix: Update the GAP-3 paragraph: 'allocated 560 mA output (GPS 150, radio 300, AUX 100 mA, D-R19-14) ... give 0.490 W (0.406 W before the AUX allowance). Junction estimate is 109.2-123.9 C at the 70 C bay ambient ... at 85 C it is 124.2-138.9 C ... the inferred theta ceiling for 125 C at 70 C is 112.3 C/W.'

findings.title: M3_R10's Power section says the In2 3V3 fill is 1466.52 mm2; on a0ec075e it is 1430.05 mm2
findings.contradicts: The board a0ec075e (and the section's own lead-in: 'Current circuit and native-layout facts replace the mixed historical prose'); check_r10 K-plane evidence pieces_mm2 '3V3 In2.Cu': [1430.05]
findings.evidence: docs/M3_R10.md line 712, bullet 'In2 3V3 plane (D-R18-06)': 'The In2 3V3 fill is one piece, 1466.52 mm2'. pcbnew GetFilledPolysList(In2.Cu) of the 3V3 zone (.supervisor/r27_power/area.py): one outline, 1430.05 mm2 on a0ec075e; 1431.06 mm2 on 92c3ad59 (3d8e845's board); check_r10 --only K-plane reports the same 1430.05 (.supervisor/r27_power/k_power_plane.json). 1466.52 mm2 was D-R18-06's measurement on its own board (round19_power.md line 58); later fill changes (the D-R20-08 tab keep-out, J440, D-R26-01's partner-via antipads) reduced it.
findings.impact: A stale plane-area figure is presented as the current board's. No rule depends on the area; K-plane's one-piece and neck checks pass.
findings.concrete_fix: M3_R10 line 712: 'The In2 3V3 fill is one piece, 1430.05 mm2 on a0ec075e (1466.52 mm2 when D-R18-06 joined it; it was three pieces ... on 632a9ad3)'.

observations: D-R26-03 reproduces exactly from parts_budget.json (fire_current_GAP1 four-stall 5.7132 V primary / 5.7112 V typical-hot) and an independent worst-corner EN model: single drop-out 8.067 ms (8.204 at 5.73 V), window limit 7.503 ms (7.629 / 5.871 / 9.594 ms at 5.73 / 5.5 / 6.0 V), 7 ms line margin 0.50 ms and holds down to 5.6465 V, EN at the 7 ms line 1.12954 V (1.13295 V at 5.73 V), fast-chatter 19.716 % (20.007 / 24.408 %), periodic 19.6 / 18.6 / 17.4 / 14.8 / 11.4 / 4.5 % at 0.1-8 ms, late-block 1.11677 / 1.11623 V at 7.6 / 7.62 ms (5.73 V), exchange identity 0.17625 V.

Rule 8's corner reproduces: 5.7132 V healthy, 5.5576 V match shorted (hot R134), 5.5555 V (cold 2.02 ohm, 20 C copper), 5.5085 V match and leads shorted; 5.37 V needs 13.53 A. With R134 at its 1.98 ohm floor the shorted corners are 5.550 / 5.501 V, still 5.55 / 5.50; zeroing every FET and allowance gives 5.48 V, whose VLOGIC (about 5.32 V) stays above the PA6 top 5.27 V.

Every current quote of the chatter and rule 8 figures (AGENTS row 1, STATUS, REQUIREMENTS F4 / F6 / line 106, M3_R10 lines 58 / 310 / 1099, ORDERING 619, R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF 67-69, R10_VALIDATION rows 21 / 25 and section 4's C87 row, parts_qualification lines 20 / 36, the binding note) carries 5.71 V; remaining 5.73 V figures are dated history or labelled comparisons. Binding note text equals the generator (chatter obligation and rule 8, byte-identical).

Other EN figures reproduce: turn-on 30.3-130.3 ms; nominal 88 / 56 / 45 ms and 19 / 33 / 41 ms; pack window on 4.723-5.251 V, off 4.288-4.802 V; Pack row turn-off 4.802 / 4.835 / 4.875 V (4.778 / 4.811 / 4.851 V without D402); single 10 ms drop-out needs 5.9556 V; F4's 8 ms / 50 ms at 5.96 V gives 1.0878 V; 3 x 4 ms train 1.0277 / 1.0246 V at 5.73 / 5.71 V; 8 ms / 50 ms at 6.0 V 1.0953 V.
Post-trip hold-up 0.103-0.164 / 0.291-0.430 ms and fraction 0.22-0.31 reproduce from battery_break_load_W at 300.8 uF; break-to-3.8 V 0.464-0.539 / 1.304-1.412 ms match parts_budget.json.

VLOGIC '0.09-0.16 V lower': the 0.16 V upper end reproduces with U9 <= 45 mOhm and U11 <= 85 mOhm at about 2.4 A / 0.42 A; the lower end depends on Ron and load assumptions, but only the upper end matters for the PA6 margin.

parts_qualification lines 661-668 ('Inference, stall input') quote 5.921 / 4.436 V for 7.4 / 6.0 V open packs with 1.46 A of port output, the pre-AUX allocation (parts_budget.json pack_7V4 / 6V0_four_stall_loaded_V 5.899 / 4.414 V); the paragraph also cites port enables the always-on amendment supersedes, so it reads as legacy text rather than a current claim.

Rule 4's '0.93-1.01x the 1.125 A floor' encloses the -20 C and Q120-removed variants of round23_safety_severity_check (1.043-1.137 A); the stated 1.128 / 1.063 A reproduce from the current budget with a 0.7 / 1.0 V body diode.

K-power (14 paths, IPC-2152 floors 0.68 / 0.326 / 0.157 / 0.167 / 0.299 / 0.356 mm all met), K-plane (one piece per inner power fill; 3V3 necks 0.549 / 0.549 / 0.589 / 0.706 mm with (19.55, 55.825) and (9.2, 52.55) as landings, identical widths to 92c3ad59), K-width, S-9, K-binding, K-fill and F9-1 pass on a0ec075e.

Regulator taps: K-power single-via-open survey shows single points only at the listed SINGLE_OPEN_EXCEPTIONS (EN (17.10, 82.80) owner respin item, USB_LIMITED (22.00, 62.25), USB_ILIM (14.82, 26.00), U10 GND island (9.00, 27.84), R8 (9.95, 30.60), VCAP1 (29.25, 38.00), U4 GND (16.75, 47.60)); every FB / OVLO / ILIM tap has two paths.

Moved 3V3A trunk: all 3V3A copper is 0.25 mm (B.Cu x 16.5 column, In2 run (16.0, 50.2)-(26.05, 50.2)); R164's 3V3 strap and R13's are 0.2 mm; at the few-mA 3V3A load (VDDA, U4, U5 through R164 2.2 ohm) IPC-2152 needs far less; no rule names a 3V3A design current.

Hot-plug: hotplug_inputs.json is bound to a0ec075e (F9-1 OK); 2304 rows pass; extremes -14.807373 V, 8.994764 / 5.087664 V/us, damper 579.049 W / 2.979359 mJ, retained 5.914 V at 1643.90 uF, as M3_R10 states.
Rail nominals and bounds reproduce: PORT_5V3 5.456 V (56.2 k + 2 k over 10 k at 0.8 V), PORT_4V8 4.792 V; OVLO corner 10.18 V; U10 limit 0.3477-0.4530 A; USB-only 0.4596 A at 5.00 V.

U400's RAW_PROTECTED input (In2 vias (14.1, 7.6) / (14.1, 8.5), 0.4 mm F.Cu to U400.2 / .3) is not a K-power path; 0.4 mm external carries about 2.14 A at a 30 C IPC-2152 rise against about 1.8-2.1 A of port-buck input at the low-pack corner, so it meets the width without a gate entry.
In2 3V3 has a pinch of about 0.47 mm to a roughly 14 mm2 dead-end finger with no landing (deflation scan); K-plane ignores landing-free pieces by design, and M3_R10's 'about 0.50 mm' approximates it.
M3_R10's USB-only bullet uses a 63.605 mm In2 USB_LIMITED track; it is 63.115 mm now (0.0905 vs 0.0912 ohm); the bullet is labelled a Round 18 calculation.
The four-stall model lumps the board's own battery lead into the 0.15 ohm source resistance, as REQUIREMENTS Pack defines it ('including leads and connector').
R10_VALIDATION line 2933's R164 via (19.05, 55.9) and 0.6761 / 0.8352 mm are in the 'Historical round10 deviations' section.
